name: file_field
label: Hero video
help_text: Optional background video (MP4 recommended). Leave empty to show the hero image only.

name: image
label: Hero image
help_text: Used as the video poster while the video loads, or as the full background when no video is selected.
inline_help_text: Prefer JPG or PNG at roughly viewport width. HubSpot serves an optimized WebP to supporting browsers automatically.
